# Lumos

Lumos is the portfolio and service catalog of full-stack developer Hwemo Chung. The site offers legacy hybrid-app diagnosis, production support, web automation, and small software tools. Shared navigation supports Korean, English, and Japanese.

## Main pages

- Home: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/
- Services and pricing: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/sales/
- Offer catalog: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/offers/
- Legacy Cordova/Ionic diagnosis: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/cordova.html
- Production retainer: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/retainer.html
- Threads analyzer: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/threads-analyzer.html
- Micro SaaS tools: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/micro-saas-mvps/
- Privacy: https://hwemo-chung.github.io/pp.html
